name: TasteMatch
qualification: Dataset inspection is fixture-qualified and one bounded base-SigLIP image inference passed through the compiled workbench on an owner-staged Modal L4 environment. Training remains unqualified.

environment.python: CPython 3.12 on Linux x86-64; a compatible GPU environment is recommended for real SigLIP inference
environment.accelerator: CPU for fixtures; a compatible CUDA-capable GPU is practical for real SigLIP inference
dependencies: PyTorch compatible with the selected host
environment.installation: Create an isolated environment, then install a reviewed PyTorch/Transformers stack appropriate to the host. Automated ML dependency installation is not qualified by this alpha.

acquisitions.name: Food-101 dataset
acquisitions.access: The dataset contains third-party imagery and its use notice applies. ModelForge does not download, accept terms, or redistribute it.
acquisitions.instructions: Review the official notice, acquire the dataset yourself, and bind its absolute root with --use food101-data=PATH.

acquisitions.name: Google SigLIP model snapshot
acquisitions.access: Hugging Face access and model-card terms apply; the full multi-file snapshot has no single declared content digest here.
acquisitions.instructions: Acquire the exact snapshot through an official Hugging Face client, verify its revision, and bind the existing cache snapshot with --use siglip-model=PATH.

actions.qualification: Bounded path-only index inspection is covered with authored fixtures; real Food-101 bytes are not distributed.
One pinned-model, selected-image base-SigLIP run completed through the shared managed Modal lifecycle and rendered a native table; no trained adapter or quality claim is included.
The known dependency-identity, materialization, summary, and telemetry drift remains unresolved.
